scenes.title: Wait, Are You the Waiter?
scenes.summary: A colleague on a first date realizes the helpful man sitting across from her is also working his shift as the restaurant's waiter.

scenes.title: Six Days On, One Day Off
scenes.summary: Between closing table checks and introducing live music, the employee explains why his six-by-one work schedule leaves no other day for their date.
scenes.location: restaurant dining room and stage microphone

scenes.title: A Light Relationship or Red Wine?
scenes.summary: The colleague mistakes a menu question for a question about relationship goals, and the overworked employee forgets she is his date.

scenes.title: Chiropractor and Ride-Share Driver
scenes.summary: The employee performs a chiropractic adjustment tableside and then accepts his date's ride-share request home in his own car.
scenes.location: restaurant dining room and outside curb
